DIAGNOSIS READY: Cholangiocarcinoma.

The combination of painless jaundice, pruritus, weight loss, pale stools, dark urine, heavy alcohol use, smoking history, and elevated tumor markers like CA 19-9 is highly suggestive of a malignant obstruction of the bile ducts, likely due to cholangiocarcinoma. Further imaging or biopsy would be needed to confirm the exact location and stage, but the clinical picture strongly points to this diagnosis.
